title: The Little Tuk
summary: Little Tuk had to learn his geography lesson for school the next morning, but he had to rock his baby sister's cradle and run errands for his old mother until late at night....
full_text:
Little Tuk had to learn his geography lesson for school the next morning, but he had to rock his baby sister's cradle and run errands for his old mother until late at night.

He tucked his heavy geography book beneath his pillow and fell asleep in tears, afraid of failing his examination.

In his dream, the towns and rivers of Denmark came alive! King Valdemar rode on a fiery steed, the ancient cathedral of Roskilde chimed its bells, and the storks danced on church roofs, whispering all the history and geography directly into his heart.

In the morning, Little Tuk recited every question with effortless brilliance, praised by the schoolmaster for his outstanding wisdom.
moral: Faithful performance of family duties brings wisdom and blessings in the school of life.
